resources.string: Wireless probe
Wireless probe
Checks whether the car offers wireless Android Auto to this phone, then (W1) reads its wireless setup without joining its Wi-Fi. Asks for Nearby devices when opened.
Open wireless probe

Checks whether a paired device advertises the wireless Android Auto service over Bluetooth. This first check is read-only: it asks the device which services it offers and connects to nothing.

If it does, a second button appears (W1). That one connects to the service and reads what the car sends, including its Wi-Fi details, then disconnects without joining the Wi-Fi. The Wi-Fi password is never kept; the network name and address are kept only as scrambled fingerprints.

Have the car on and connected to this phone over Bluetooth as usual, with the USB cable unplugged. Then tap the car below. Each run is saved as a report; use Export saved reports under Diagnostics to take it off the phone.

Link the car for wireless

Links the app to the car through Android\'s own dialog, once; turning this on asks for Nearby devices first. From then on, whenever the car connects to this phone over Bluetooth, Android wakes the app and the app waits for the car. Pressing Android Auto on the car\'s screen then projects over the car\'s Wi-Fi, with the phone in a pocket and the app closed, as with Android Auto. After a wireless session ends, the app waits again until the car disconnects.\n\nWi-Fi must be on and the cable unplugged; with the cable in, the cable is used. It works only for a head unit already trusted over USB. Turning this off removes the link, and Android stops waking the app.
Start wirelessly when the car connects

Needs the car link above. On, the app also takes the car\'s own offer to start when it connects, or to restart after a drop, so projection starts without pressing anything. Off, only the Android Auto button on the car\'s screen, or Connect wirelessly here, starts it.\n\nAfter you stop or cancel a wireless session from the phone, only the button starts it again until the car next connects. The same happens after three automatic starts in a row that each end within two minutes.
